query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as faturamento,
  SUM(si.quantity * p.avgCost) as custo_total,
  SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) - SUM(si.quantity * p.avgCost) as lucro_bruto,
  SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) * 0.07 as taxa_ifood,
  SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) - SUM(si.quantity * p.avgCost) - (SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) * 0.07) as lucro_liquido
FROM sales s
INNER JOIN saleItems si ON si.saleId = s.id
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE s.saleType = 'DELIVERY' 
  AND s.status != 'CANCELLED'
  AND MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '-03:00'))
  AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '-03:00'))
